card.name: Leading digit of a large number
card.fires_on: The first digit of a multi-digit number (such as 4, 7 or 2) when it starts a figure of hundreds or thousands. Usually seen in patient counts or mg/kg dose figures after 'and', 'to' or 'versus'.

modes.label: Group sizes
modes.description: First digit of a patient or subject count in a comparison group.

modes.label: Dose amounts
modes.description: First digit of a dose figure in mg/kg or mg/day, often the second value in a pair or range.
modes.example: dosages ranging from 5400 to <<7>>200 mg/day for durations between

card.plain: It fires on the first digit of a big number, like a group size or dose, before the rest of the digits.
